name: sentinel
description: Real-time intelligent code security analyzer — detects vulnerabilities as you type

commands.title: Sentinel: Scan Entire Workspace & Sync Database
Sentinel: Set Gemini API Key (AI Fixing)

sentinel.enabled.description: Enable or disable Sentinel real-time analysis

enumDescriptions: Follow the active VS Code colour theme
sentinel.theme.description: Colour mode for Sentinel's dashboards and panels

sentinel.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay (ms) before running analysis after a code change

sentinel.backendUrl.description: URL of the Member 2 backend API for sending security events

sentinel.developerId.description: Your developer identifier for behaviour tracking

sentinel.enableAI.description: Enable AI-assisted vulnerability analysis via the Intelligent Feedback Engine (IFE)

sentinel.ifeUrl.description: URL of the Intelligent Feedback Engine (Component 3) for AI-generated explanations and personalised fixes

sentinel.api.enabled.description: Run the local Sentinel API server so Component 2 (Behaviour Tracker) can pull detection, behaviour, feedback and shift data

sentinel.api.port.description: Port for the local Sentinel API server (bound to 127.0.0.1 only)

sentinel.api.key.description: Optional shared secret. When set, Component 2 must send it in the X-Sentinel-Api-Key header

sentinel.minConfidence.description: Minimum detection confidence threshold (0.0–1.0). Findings below this score are hidden. Lower = more alerts, higher = fewer but more precise.

enumDescriptions: Show a VS Code pop-up for every Sentinel notification
No pop-ups; use the bell in the dashboard
sentinel.notifications.popups.description: Which Sentinel notifications appear as VS Code pop-ups

sentinel.notifications.shiftReminderMinu.description: Remind assigned developers and the supervisor this many minutes before a shift starts (0 = off)

sentinel.aiFix.model.description: Google Gemini model used by Detect › AI Fixing (e.g. gemini-flash-latest, gemini-pro-latest if your key has Pro quota). If it is overloaded or out of quota, Sentinel falls back to gemini-flash-latest, gemini-2.5-flash, then gemini-flash-lite-latest.
